Package com.lab_lib.restapi.Repositories

Interface RecommendedBookRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<RecommendedBook,Long>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<RecommendedBook,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<RecommendedBook,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<RecommendedBook,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<RecommendedBook,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<RecommendedBook>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<RecommendedBook,Long>
@Repository public interface RecommendedBookRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<RecommendedBook,Long>
Repository JPA per l'entità RecommendedBook.

Definisce metodi per verificare esistenze, ricerche per libro e conteggio delle raccomandazioni per utente.
